normalized.description:
The subject of this call for tenders is to demonstrate the feasibility of implementing the most promising and mature On-board Resilience Techniques against GNSS Frequency Jamming and Spoofing in a GNSS Receiver Prototype or Demonstrator (hardware and/or software). The objective is to get this Receiver Prototype/Demonstrator to, as a minimum, a Technology Readiness Level of TRL4 (technology validated in lab) or TRL5 (technology validated in relevant environment) , or higher if possible, taking into account the state of the art in the science and applications of navigation.
Additionally, it is also an objective to perform some technological studies to better support future developments: Assess which are the optimal complementary technologies depending on the domain; Assess the GNSS receiver behaviour in the presence of an RFI event and Assess the possibility of including the results of the implementation of the On-board GNSS Resilience Techniques in a real receiver.
